title: 盛って盛って、めっちゃ盛んぞー！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as we're wrapping up training, I notice Tosen Jordan gazing out over the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I just remembered I have something to do. You go on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may have said I can leave, but I can't help worrying, so I decide to follow her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh… After all this running, my time isn't getting any better… Why?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey. Do you have a sec?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, Jordan! S-sure! Um… what can I do for you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Um, you know the empty classroom next to the infirmary? It's a nice, quiet spot. Meet me there, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-wait!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Leeet's see… I'm pretty sure I have some in Trainer's offi—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: WHOA! You scared me! You're still here?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Anyway, perfect! Can you lend me the key to your office?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I need it, like, pronto. For real!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Tosen Jordan is planning to do something with Daiwa Scarlet…
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, okay?
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?
How about I tell you a shortcut?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Tosen Jordan is planning to do something with Daiwa Scarlet…
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, okay?
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?
How about I tell you a shortcut?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? I'm still totes good to go. It's not cool to underestimate people's stamina, you know.
choice_data_list: In that case, should we up your training load?
In that case, should we up your training load?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What? No, that's not what I'm—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Actually, you know what? Perfect! I'll do it! I'll teach you a lesson for taking me lightly!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Starting tomorrow, I'll blow your eyes wide open! You'll see!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: There's a shortcut?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her the easiest way to run straight to my office from here.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No cap?! That means… I can chill right up until practice is about to start from now on!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Kidding! That was a joke! Geez, don't look so serious!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Heh, you really are a pro when it comes to running. Thanks for the help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I leave the training ground and am walking around campus when I hear excited voices coming from a classroom.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah! ☆ Whaddya think?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Th-that's a lot of press-on nails… Okay… Well, I have to get to back to training…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Chill out. You can spare a minute, right? Now, what design do you want?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Marble? French? Oh, how about your favorite character?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Jordan, but I really have to get back to running… So…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Come on, running all the time will just tire you out. You gotta take a break now and then, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But now isn't the time…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's fiiine. They'll dry right away. You realize you're just wasting even more time arguing with me, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Uh… In that case, please, pleeease do it as quickly as possible!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No worries! I'm practically a pro when it comes to nails! All right, tell me what kind of design you want.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Erm… Well, how about a scarlet or something?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Scarlet? You want your own face on your nails?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: N-n-no! It's a flower!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm talking about those cute, bright red flowers that bloom in summer…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: They remind me of my mom and grandma. One time, after I won a race at my school sports day, they bought me a bouquet of scarlets to match my name.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: They told me that I won because I worked hard every day. The flowers were a prize for all my efforts.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's right… I…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That story is fire! Let's go with that, then!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And you should see the look on your face right now. Sure enough, the things you love always blow the bad vibes away!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's right! You helped me realize something important. I can't let myself get worn out!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: There you go! You've got it! We can build our mental strength through our nails! Let's pile on the motivation by piling more stuff on them!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: All right, one express set of nails, coming up!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, okay! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Tosen Jordan freshens up their nails and, in doing so, freshens up their spirits as well.
